user.title: Sign in to Yale Access
user.description: Use your Yale Home account to manage one lock.

data_description.country: Two uppercase letters, for example US or DK.
data_description.identifier: Use the identifier registered with your Yale account.

verify.title: Verify your Yale account
verify.description: Enter the six-digit verification code Yale sent you.

lock.title: Choose a lock
lock.description: Select the lock to manage with Home Assistant.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to Yale Access again
reauth_confirm.description: Sign in with an account that can access the configured lock.

error.invalid_auth: Yale rejected these login details. Check your account and password.
error.invalid_code: The verification code is invalid. Enter the six-digit code Yale sent you.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to Yale. Try again.
error.unknown: Yale returned an unexpected response. Try again.

abort.no_locks: No locks are available to this Yale account.
abort.wrong_account: This Yale account cannot access the configured lock.
abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one Yale Access integration can be configured.

person.title: Choose a person
person.description: Select the Home Assistant user whose access you want to configure.

person_details.title: Configure access
person_details.description: Set the role, own Yale user and assigned Yale users. Select None to remove this person's integration access.

data_description.own_yale_user: Allows this person to view and change their own code, including when protected.
data_description.yale_users: Additional Yale users this person may manage.

protected.title: Protected users
protected.description: Hide these Yale users from lists and protect their access. Configured own-code controls remain available.

notify.title: Login notifications
notify.description: Optionally choose a notification service for the administrator's login-health alerts. Leave empty to disable alerts.

error.yale_user_taken: A Yale user can only be selected once across all own and assigned users.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to retrieve Yale users. Try again.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Try again.

abort.not_loaded: Yale Access must be loaded before it can be configured.
